propositions: The wiki_render_hardening test intermittently crashes its pytest-xdist worker on macOS py3.13 due to exceeding the 300-second per-test timeout budget.

The test performs ~1768 serial pandoc spawns on 884 renderable units in a single monolithic loop, measuring 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding the 300s guard by 1.7x on contended hardware.
pytest-timeout with thread method kills the worker process via os._exit(1) without raising a traceback, producing a worker crash report with no assertion text.
The fix chunks the test into 40-unit batches via pytest.mark.parametrize, bounding per-test cost to ~4.2s idle and distributing work across xdist workers.
A coverage guard test verifies that all 884 units are still compared by asserting chunk concatenation equals _renderable_units() with total >= 100.
The byte-identity property between _convert and _legacy_convert oracle remains unchanged; all units are still rendered with real pandoc and _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE remains 1.
